# BAD-080 — collab clients: keep the seat hot through a take's push so the server grace is the belt, not the path

## Brief
BAD-063's server fix admits a take into a wrapped room for a bounded grace because the seat goes cold at the stop beat and both shipped clients open a push with an info call, which is a read that completes the wrap before upload-url is even attempted. The design's own intent is that whoever is mid-part finishes; the client is the only party that knows a take is still being delivered. Either send recording:true until the commit lands (web/collabweb-sync.js collabHeartbeat + booth stop; main.js collab:heartbeat; the iOS shell inherits web), or stop opening pushTakes/collab:push with an info round trip. With that, the grace only ever covers another member's poll landing mid-upload. Alternative if a server-side hot window is preferred: a recording_stopped_at (or hot_until) column on collab_claims, which needs a migration and was out of BAD-063's deliverables.

Evidence: web/collabweb-sync.js:8-52 (pushTakes opens with info, then upload-url, PUT, commit) and :173-192 (collabHeartbeat(false) on stop and every idle 60s tick); main.js collab:push (same shape) and :4234-4248; server/supabase/functions/collab/room.ts wrap-on-read; the new WRAP_GRACE_MS comment in _shared/collab.mjs names this as the case standing aside cannot cover.
